address: Huaxi Street Night Market, Stall 153, 17-4 Huaxi Street, Wanhua District, Taipei, Taiwan
bio: After starting out as a street stall in the night market over 45 years ago, it has since morphed into a full-blown restaurant with a bright, spruce interior. The room is filled with the heady aromas of its signature item – ‘black gold’ braised pork rice with a gelatinous sauce that tastes savoury-sweet. The rice goes well with stewed cabbage that cuts through the richness. Minced pork and pickled cucumber in broth are bouncy in texture and loaded with flavour. As well as minced pork and pickled cucumber in broth, try their steamed rice with ‘black gold’ pork sauce.
